stories.title: Define Specialty Match Accuracy Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a strict response schema for specialty match accuracy including: condition-derived NUCC codes, provider NUCC codes, normalized match_score (0–1), match_type (exact | partial | mismatch), and explanation fields to support transparency and downstream UI rendering.

stories.title: Implement Specialty Match Accuracy Scoring Logic
stories.description: Implement deterministic scoring logic comparing condition-derived NUCC taxonomy codes to provider taxonomy codes, including exact matches, hierarchical proximity within NUCC taxonomy, and mismatch handling, aligned with outputs from the dual-pipeline specialty_service.

stories.title: Expose Specialty Match Accuracy via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate specialty match scoring into evaluate_care_facade and ensure compatibility with tool_router so responses include match_score, classification, and NUCC mappings while preserving existing provider detail response contracts.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Specialty Match Accuracy
stories.description: Develop unit tests for exact, partial, mismatch, and edge scenarios (multi-specialty providers, ambiguous conditions), plus integration tests validating end-to-end flow from specialty extraction through evaluate_care_facade output contract.

stories.title: Integration Handling for Multi-Specialty and Ambiguity Cases
stories.description: Implement integration-layer handling for providers with multiple NUCC codes, ensuring deduplication and consistent scoring outputs when invoked via evaluate_care_facade, including fallback behavior for ambiguous condition-to-specialty mappings without altering core scoring logic.
